THE BUILD

The thinking behind the page.

A useful project has to connect its interface to the visitor’s task.

Audience

People who need a clear path into HappyHealing HappyFeeling and an interface they can understand quickly.

Experience

Clear product presentation and a coherent brand feel across the store.

Next iteration

Review real visitor feedback and refine the areas where people hesitate or need more context.

Interface decisions

A storefront is both a catalog and an introduction to the brand. Product organization, readable descriptions and a clear buying path help visitors decide with confidence.

What I would keep refining

Handloom products benefit from context: fabric, craft, care and imagery. Those details give the page substance beyond a generic product grid.
